title: A carton folding inspection
passage: Yesterday, some cartons sprang open after forming. Today, fold one by hand along its crease, then let go of it on the table. If the edge springs open, keep a flat blank from the same stack for the materials team. If it holds, ask the line lead to watch the next machine cycle. Skip the tape for this check: it would hide whether the edge stays closed on its own.
passageZh: 昨天有些紙箱成形後自行彈開。今天請沿原有摺痕用手摺一個，再放到桌上鬆手。如果摺邊彈開，請從同一疊留一張未摺的紙箱坯給材料小組。如果摺邊維持閉合，請產線組長觀察機器的下一個運轉循環。這項檢查不要貼膠帶，否則看不出摺邊能否自行維持閉合。
